chapter: Road life, arranging and racial dangers
title: Lester Young did not drink, smoke or chase girls
summary: Smith says young Lester Young never drank, smoked or chased girls and was amazed when he later started drinking.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Was Lester drinking much in those days?
He didn't drink, didn't smoke, and didn't chase girls.
That's incredible. Because Lester by the early '40s was drinking a lot.

Yeah. I was amazed when I found out that he had started drinking. He wouldn't drink nothin'. The guys would go party and he'd go with the guys, they'd go to them parties and things, after-hour parties and all that kind of stuff, but he wouldn't drink nothin'.
